papers.title: Navodaya Model Paper 01 (Daily Practice)
papers.description: A curated 10-question daily challenge covering Mental Ability, Arithmetic, and Language to test readiness and build confidence.

questions.question_text: Four figures are given. Three are alike in some way and one is different. Choose the odd one out:
questions.explanation: Options A, B, and C are closed geometrical polygons formed by straight lines (Triangle, Square, Pentagon), whereas Option D is a Circle formed by a continuous curved line with no vertices.

questions.question_text: Analogy: If Circle is to Sphere, then Square is to:
questions.explanation: A circle is a 2D geometric shape whose 3D counterpart is a sphere. Similarly, a square is a 2D shape whose 3D counterpart is a cube.

questions.question_text: Pattern Completion: A clock hand points to 12, then to 3, then to 6. Where will it point next?
questions.explanation: The hand rotates 90 degrees clockwise in each step: 12 -> 3 -> 6. Rotating another 90 degrees clockwise points directly to 9.

questions.question_text: What is the difference between the place value and face value of 7 in the number 27,845?
questions.explanation: In 27,845, the digit 7 is at the thousands place, so its place value = 7,000. Its face value is 7. Difference = 7,000 - 7 = 6,993.

questions.question_text: The HCF of two numbers is 16 and their product is 3072. What is their LCM?
questions.explanation: We know that Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM. Therefore, LCM = Product / HCF = 3072 / 16 = 192.

questions.question_text: A bus leaves Delhi at 9:15 AM and reaches Chandigarh at 3:45 PM on the same day. What was the total travel duration?
questions.explanation: From 9:15 AM to 12:00 Noon is 2 hours 45 minutes. From 12:00 Noon to 3:45 PM is 3 hours 45 minutes. Total = 2h 45m + 3h 45m = 5h 90m = 6 hours 30 minutes.

questions.question_text: Read: "A tiny bird built her nest on the topmost branch of an oak tree to keep her eggs safe from prowling foxes." Why did the bird build the nest on the topmost branch?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly states she chose the topmost branch "to keep her eggs safe from prowling foxes".

questions.question_text: Select the correct opposite (antonym) of the word "Courageous":
questions.explanation: "Courageous" means brave and fearless. Its exact opposite is "Cowardly" or timid.

questions.question_text: Choose the word that correctly fills the blank: "Rohan has been waiting for the school bus _____ 7:00 AM."
questions.explanation: We use "since" to denote a specific starting point in time (7:00 AM) with the present perfect continuous tense.
